Interface TransportConnection

All Known Subinterfaces:
MeshtasticConnection
All Known Implementing Classes:
BleConnection, SerialConnection, TcpConnection
public interface TransportConnection
Low-level transport connection used by protocol adapters.

Implementations own only the byte-stream lifecycle: open, close, write bytes prepared by the active protocol, and deliver inbound payloads upward. Business logic for a specific radio network or protocol does not belong here.
